text:
alex: Heads-up — we’re running a weekly spot-eviction drill tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Goal: validate regional failover, autoscaler dry-run, and quota fallback paths. Please post short what-you-did / blockers / plan.

maria: I ran the preflight smoke for the sim infra earlier, passes on staging. No KV-cache regressions. I can run full sim at 08:15 UTC.

cheng: Checked fleet headroom: eu-west1 A100 pool has ~420 GPUs free, us-west1 has ~260, ap-southeast-1 only ~40 (spot-heavy). Recommend +12% buffer for ap-southeast-1.

sam: Cloud quota request for ap-southeast-1 still pending (case #CLOUD-8742). I emailed support, they asked for expected QPS and retention window. I can escalate if needed. @cheng fyi.

lina: For routing: do we want a 5% canary to the fallback model variant before full shift? quick snippet for rollout: ```json
{
  "route": "eu-west1",
  "canary_pct": 5,
  "fallback": "redwood-quant-t4-v2"
}
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled drill job created: drills/spot-evict/2039991111 (runs 09:00 UTC). Notifying oncall.

ops-bot: Reminder: autoscaler will run in dry-run mode unless LABEL_RUN=true. Dry-run will not terminate nodes but will print evict plan.

alex: Action items: cheng confirm buffers + any hotfix capacity; maria run full sim at 08:15 and paste top-level output; sam escalate quota with cloud if no reply by EOD; lina owns rollback doc and canary config.

cheng: I’ll bump buffer in the provisioning config for ap-southeast-1 to 15% and open PR: https://git.company/repo/infra/PR-4523. Will tag @alex @maria.

sam: Opened support escalation, added expected QPS and retention numbers. Ticket now at P2. MR for temporary soft quota fallback is queued.

maria: Ran sim (08:15) — summary lines: `evict-sim: removed 12 nodes, degraded latency: 1.2% p95, embedding pipeline re-routed ok`. Full logs: https://logs.company/drills/2039991111. No blocking errors.

lina: Rollback doc link: https://confluence.company/infra/drills/rollback — plan uses 1) cancel rollout, 2) route back to primary with 0% canary, 3) trigger autoscaler manual-surge. I’ll add the CLI steps.

alex: Perfect. Blockers so far: quota pending (sam) and ap-southeast low headroom (cheng). If cloud doesn’t approve, we fall back to quantized t4s and restrict burst to dedicated pools only.

maria: I’ll be oncall during the run and will post TL;DR after completion.

cheng: PR merged and provisioning pushed to staging. Will monitor allocated headroom metrics.

sam: Will update thread if we hear from cloud. Also pinging partners. :iphone:

alex: Thanks all — keep updates short in this thread during the drill. :thumbsup:
